example_utterances: when will my order be dispatched
do you deliver to my country

resolution_config.answer:
Here are our shipping options:

| Option | Delivery Time | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Standard (Portugal) | 2–4 business days | Free on orders over €50, else €3.99 |
| Express (Portugal) | Next business day | €7.99 |
| EU International | 5–10 business days | €9.99 |
| Rest of World | 10–21 business days | €14.99 |

**Dispatch cut-off:** Orders placed before **2 PM (weekdays)** ship the same day.

**Tracking:** You'll receive a tracking link by email as soon as your parcel is collected by the courier.

**Delays:** During sale periods or public holidays, please allow 1–2 extra business days.
